prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it is confirmed that the student has passed all other subjects of the study plan and, therefore, has all the necessary credits to obtain the Bachelor's degree, except for those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to integrate all general and specific competencies in the field of the Degree studies pursued.

assessment_methods.method: Tracking of student's on-site activities by their academic tutor
Final document submitted by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent discussion with it

assessment_rules: The Final Degree Project must be presented and defended before a university tribunal. Both ordinary and extraordinary evaluation are carried out through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors from the School. Although the Final Degree Project may be part of a joint work in which more than one student may have participated, the presentation must be individual, clearly specifying the particular aspects or contribution of each student to the whole. The final definition of the evaluation system will comply with the regulations defined in the Final Degree Regulations of the School of Engineering.
bibliography: Regulation of TFG of the School of Engineering, which complements the Generic Regulation of TFG of the University of Oviedo (BOPA of July 17, 2012).

Generic Regulation, as well as the specific one for the School of Engineering, and other related documents (such as the Act and the Evaluation Matrix, among others) are updated on the Web: http://www.epigijon.uniovi.es/index.php/2013-04-12-11-26-07/trabajo-fin-de-grado
